page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute instance belonging to the Enhanced server family, operating under the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor rated at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The memory configuration provides 32.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is absent, with 0 GPUs included in the configuration.

Storage and networking specifications highlight an external-storage-dependent architecture. The instance includes no local storage volumes, necessitating network-attached block storage for operating system images and persistent operational data. For networking, the system provides a baseline bandwidth capacity of 12 Gbps, while zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory distribution offers standard resource density for enterprise compute environments without the overhead of specialized local drive arrays or dedicated accelerators. This hardware profile aligns with general-purpose workloads, including web application hosting, mid-sized database management systems, microservices architectures, and business automation platforms that require steady dedicated compute resources and baseline 12 Gbps networking.
